name: remember
description: Save a lasting fact about the user: ALWAYS call it when they tell you something about themselves worth knowing later (their car, family, job, home, likes, plans, preferences) or say remember. Write it as a short standalone sentence, e.g. "Drives a 2021 Dodge Charger".

name: reminder
description: Create an iPhone reminder. due is ISO 8601 with the user UTC offset.

name: event
description: Add an event to the iPhone Calendar right away (no need to ask first; it can be undone). start: ISO 8601 with the local UTC offset, worked out from today's date. place (optional): where it is; adds a time-to-leave alert. Read back the title, day and time from the result.

name: email
description: Open an email draft for the user to send.

name: navigate
description: Start Apple Maps directions.

name: save_spot
description: Remember the user's current location, e.g. where they parked. label defaults to car.

name: find_spot
description: Where did I park / take me back to a saved spot. Opens walking directions.

name: place_reminder
description: Reminder that goes off when the user arrives at or leaves a place ("remind me when I get home"). place: home, work, a saved spot, an address or a store name.

name: what_you_know
description: List what Alice remembers about the user ("what do you know about me?").

name: forget
description: Forget a remembered fact. match: the exact fact text as it appears in what you know.

name: take_notes
description: Meeting notes. action start: Alice goes quiet, records and transcribes the meeting; stop: writes summary, decisions and action items. Say the result back.

name: directions
description: Spoken turn-by-turn directions through the glasses from where the user is now (the app knows their location). to: address, business or place; mode: driving or walking. If the result lists options and asks which one, read them, let the user pick, then call again with the same to and choice 1-3. Otherwise read back the overview.

name: stop_directions
description: Stop turn-by-turn directions.

name: catch_up
description: What did I miss: rest of today, next events, timers, weather. Say the result.

name: person_note
description: Remember something about a person the user introduces or describes ("this is Mike from work", "Sarah's birthday is May 3").

name: person_info
description: What Alice knows about a person ("who is Mike?", "what do I know about Sarah?").

name: read_this
description: Read an article or text aloud: what the user copied, or url. summarize true to sum it up instead. If it says it is reading, just say okay.

name: daily_recap
description: Recap the user's day (calendar, finished reminders, notes, meetings). Say the result.

name: learn_word
description: Learn how to hear and spell a name or word the user says ("learn the name Kylee, K-Y-L-E-E"), or one you got wrong.

name: undo_last
description: Undo the event or reminder just added ("undo", "remove that").

name: scan_doc
description: Scan a paper document (one or more pages) into a PDF with its text, saved in Files. Say the result.

name: photo_file
description: Take a picture (flyer, appointment card, ticket, receipt, whiteboard...) and file it: target calendar, reminder, note or auto. fromLibrary true to pick an existing photo. Say the result.

name: run_shortcut
description: Run one of the user's Siri Shortcuts by name (e.g. smart-home lights, thermostat, scenes).

name: list_add
description: Add items to a list in iPhone Reminders (shopping, to-do, any name; created if missing).

name: list_read
description: Read what is on a list.

name: list_check
description: Check off / remove an item from a list.

name: emergency
description: User needs help: prepares a text with their location to their emergency contacts.

name: call_911
description: Call 911. ONLY after the user clearly says yes to calling 911.

name: call
description: Phone call to a contact ("call Mom").

name: text
description: Text message to a contact; opens Messages filled in.

name: timer
description: Countdown timer in seconds, optional label.

name: alarm
description: Alarm at a local date-time (ISO 8601 with offset), optional label.

name: show_camera
description: Turn the live camera view on so you can SEE: use it when the user asks what they are looking at, to read something, identify something, or "look at this". Then describe what you see in the incoming frames. on:false to close it.

name: cancel_timers
description: Cancel the timers and alarms Alice set.

name: play_music
description: Play an artist, song, album or playlist. app: apple (default) or spotify.

name: translator
description: Turn the two-way interpreter on (with a language) or off.

name: briefing
description: Daily briefing: today's schedule, the weather here and the top headlines. Use for "brief me", "good morning", "what does my day look like".

name: look_up
description: Search the web for current, live information: news, sports scores, stock and crypto prices, events, opening hours, people in the news, anything recent or that changes. Use it whenever you are not sure your knowledge is current.

name: stop_listening
description: End the conversation and stop listening when the user says stop listening, go to sleep, that's all, be quiet, or similar.

name: report_problem
description: Add a problem report to Alice's diagnostic log, in the user's words, when they say something went wrong ("log that", "that didn't work", "note a problem").

name: weather
description: Live weather and forecast. Omit place for the user's current location.

name: where_am_i
description: Tell the user where they are (street/city).

name: agenda
description: What is coming up: calendar events and reminders for the next N days (default 7). Use for "what do I have today/this week/on Tuesday".

name: glasses_status
description: Glasses connection, battery and photo count.

name: recall
description: Search everything the user and Alice said in past conversations (any day). query: topic words and/or a time ("yesterday", "last week"). last: N for "the last N things I said". who: user, assistant or any.

name: shop
description: Order or buy something from a store (Walmart, Target, Amazon, Instacart, Kroger, Costco, Chewy...): opens the store app at that item. Remembers the usual store, brand and pickup/delivery, so only pass what the user said. The user confirms payment themselves.

name: explain
description: List the actions Alice took recently with their results, to explain why ("why did you do that?").

name: coach
description: Workout coach mode with the camera: counts reps and gives form cues. on false to stop.

name: log_set
description: Log a finished set (exercise, reps, weight in lb).

name: workout_history
description: Workout history for the last N days (default 7).

name: home_control
description: Control smart-home devices through Home Assistant with a plain command ("turn off the kitchen lights", "set the thermostat to 70", "lock the front door", "open the garage"). Try this first for devices; fall back to run_shortcut.

name: ifttt
description: Fire an IFTTT webhook applet by event name (e.g. start_car), optional value.

name: webhook
description: Run one of the user's custom connections by name (Zapier/Make/any URL).

name: music_control
description: Control Apple Music playback: pause, resume, next, previous, restart, shuffle_on, shuffle_off, repeat_on, repeat_off, stop, now_playing ("what's playing?").

name: email_check
description: Gmail inbox: new (unread) emails, or a Gmail search query (from:, subject:, words).

name: email_read
description: Read an email aloud from the last list: which = number (1,2,3), sender name or subject words.

name: email_reply
description: Reply to the email just read. FIRST read the reply text back and get a clear yes; only then call this.

name: email_send
description: Send a new email (to: contact name or address). FIRST read recipient, subject and text back and get a clear yes; only then call this.

name: email_archive
description: Archive an email from the last list (which = number, sender or "that").

name: whats_new
description: What changed in Alice's latest update ("what's new?").

name: capabilities
description: What Alice can do (a short spoken overview). Use for "what can you do?".

name: health_summary
description: Apple Health: last night's sleep, steps and active calories today, resting heart rate, HRV, workouts this week. Use it to tailor workout intensity and advice (general guidance, not medical).

name: foresight
description: Upcoming deadlines, renewals and dates found in the user's notes, meetings and conversations that are not on the calendar yet. Offer to add reminders.

name: self_check
description: Run a self-check and repair ("fix yourself", "something is wrong with you"): permissions, server, glasses, wake word. Say the result.

name: open_app
description: Open an app on the iPhone by name (Spotify, Instagram, Uber, Calendar, Settings...).

name: make_file
description: Create a real file: a resume, letter, report, form, plan (word or pdf), a spreadsheet/budget/tracker (excel) or a presentation (powerpoint). It looks up and follows any official standard (e.g. federal resume / USAJOBS rules) and uses a file the user just gave you. request: everything the user asked for, in detail. Say the result; never read the document aloud.
